event_fact_summary: Walmart revised Q2 and FY2023 profit expectations, citing markdowns, inventory actions and consumer mix shifts; full-year adjusted EPS was expected to decline materially.
materiality_reason: Unscheduled forward profit reset tied to changing consumer behavior, inventory and margin economics.

event_fact_summary: Constellation announced its largest-ever power purchase agreement, a 20-year Microsoft agreement supporting the restart of Three Mile Island Unit 1 as the Crane Clean Energy Center and adding about 835 MW of carbon-free capacity.
materiality_reason: Long-duration customer contract directly linked to a major generation-asset restart and future capacity economics.

event_fact_summary: MP Materials announced a multibillion-dollar U.S. Department of Defense partnership including equity/warrants, financing, a 10-year NdPr price-floor commitment, a 10-year magnet offtake arrangement and construction of a second domestic magnet facility.
materiality_reason: Long-duration government pricing, financing and offtake commitments materially altered future capacity, financing and cash-flow economics.

event_fact_summary: Kellogg announced a plan to separate its North American cereal and plant-based businesses, producing three independent public companies with distinct growth, margin and capital-allocation profiles.
materiality_reason: Company-wide portfolio restructuring affecting valuation framework, business mix and capital allocation.

event_fact_summary: Twitter announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by an entity owned by Elon Musk for $54.20 per share in cash, valuing the transaction at approximately $44 billion.
materiality_reason: Definitive cash acquisition directly changed target-shareholder transaction economics and completion-risk pricing.

event_fact_summary: Prologis and Duke Realty announced a definitive all-stock merger valued at approximately $26 billion including assumed debt.
materiality_reason: Definitive acquisition agreement directly changed target-shareholder transaction economics and strategic value of the logistics real-estate portfolio.

event_fact_summary: Capital One and Discover announced a definitive all-stock acquisition of Discover valued at $35.3 billion; Discover holders were to receive 1.0192 Capital One shares per share.
materiality_reason: Definitive acquisition agreement directly changed target-shareholder transaction economics and introduced material regulatory-completion risk.

event_fact_summary: Kroger and Albertsons announced a definitive merger agreement with estimated total consideration of $34.10 per Albertsons share, subject to specified reductions and transaction structure.
materiality_reason: Definitive acquisition agreement directly changed target-shareholder transaction economics and regulatory-completion risk.

event_fact_summary: Amazon and iRobot announced a definitive all-cash agreement under which Amazon would acquire iRobot for $61 per share, valued at approximately $1.7 billion including net debt.
materiality_reason: Definitive acquisition agreement directly changed target-shareholder transaction economics and regulatory-completion risk.
